title: CrewAI Platform Tools
summary: Provides a specialized tool for CrewAI agents to execute predefined actions on the CrewAI platform. It dynamically configures itself based on action schemas and handles authenticated API interactions.

nodes.label: Execute Platform Action
nodes.title: Platform Action Executor
nodes.description: A dynamically configured tool that allows agents to trigger and execute predefined actions available on the CrewAI platform by making authenticated API calls.

nodes.label: Generate Dynamic Tool Schema
nodes.title: Dynamic Schema Creator
nodes.description: Constructs Pydantic models dynamically from action schemas to define the arguments required for platform actions, ensuring type safety and validation for tool inputs.

nodes.label: Configure Platform API Access
nodes.title: API Access Configuration
nodes.description: Retrieves the base URL and authentication token necessary for securely connecting to and interacting with the CrewAI Platform API.

nodes.label: Execute & Process API Request
nodes.title: API Request Processor
nodes.description: Handles the actual HTTP POST request to the CrewAI Platform API, including payload construction, timeout management, and parsing the API response for success or error.

nodes.label: CrewAI Platform API
nodes.title: External Platform API
nodes.description: The external API endpoint of the CrewAI platform, responsible for processing and executing requested actions and returning results.

groups.label: Tool Interface
groups.title: Agent-Facing Tool
groups.description: Defines the primary interface for agents to interact with the CrewAI Platform, abstracting underlying API complexities.

groups.label: Configuration & Setup
groups.title: Tool Configuration
groups.description: Manages the dynamic setup of the tool, including argument schema generation and API access credentials.

groups.label: API Communication
groups.title: Platform API Interaction
groups.description: Handles the secure and reliable communication with the external CrewAI Platform API, including request formatting and response processing.
